comment: SHORT baseline v0. Not an invert of trend_rotation_25. Isolated CFM BTC/ETH book. Cash in bulls.
start_usd_note: Primary research capital is $10k so 1x nano-BTC lots are tradable. $1k at 1x cannot hold 1 BIP when BTC is ~$100k.
_mechanics: When BTC 4h close < BTC 200 EMA, short BTC (50% equity notional at 1x). Short ETH only if ETH 4h close is also < its 200 EMA. Cover all on BTC regime flip (close back above EMA). Per-name 2x ATR hard stop. Unused ETH sleeve stays cash. Funding charged to shorts, never credited.
